steps.en: Paste a Cloudflare token with two Workers/R2 permissions into setup
steps.zh: 设置里粘贴只含两项权限的 Cloudflare token

steps.en: Create the bucket, deploy its Worker and claim a workers.dev name
steps.zh: 建存储桶、部署 Worker、认领 workers.dev 名字

steps.en: Record from the menu bar and press Stop
steps.zh: 在菜单栏开始录制，然后按停止

steps.en: Upload segments while you record and publish the link at Stop
steps.zh: 边录边传分片，按停止时发布链接

value.en: Share a recording link whose video lives in your own Cloudflare account, with no per-seat subscription
value.zh: 分享录屏链接，视频存在自己的 Cloudflare 账号里，不用按人头订阅
